card.name: Sentence points in clinical warnings
card.fires_on: Mostly sentence-ending periods and word-starting pieces in clinical warning text about monitoring or complications. The clearest case is the word nursing in 'Appropriate nursing care'.

modes.label: Nursing care
modes.description: The word nursing in a phrase about care measures for a patient.
modes.example: Appropriate<< nursing>> care to prevent hypostatic pneumonia,

modes.label: Period after a complication
modes.description: A full stop that ends a sentence naming a condition such as imbalance, cellulitis or arrhythmias.
modes.example: Observe for development of cardiac arrhythmias<<.>> ( 7 ) Potassium-deple

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: A piece partway through a long term such as myelotoxic or hypoglycemia.
modes.example: Early warning symptoms of hyp<<og>>lycemia may be different or less

card.writes: It pushes the model toward nurse and nursing words, which suggests a next step about care or monitoring by nursing staff.
card.plain: It marks spots in warnings where the text might move on to what nurses should watch or do.
